name: Cass
title: Outfitter
examine: Salt-coast born, sailed one season, walked inland. Sizes you with one look and says the number out loud. He sold a thin coat once. The burn taught them both.
lines: You are a forty-two across the shoulders. Do not argue with a tailor.
The burn does not care what you paid. It cares what you wore.
Wool first, pride second. Pride does not hold warmth.
